case_classification.short_description: Loan Amortization Schedule for a Constant Principal Loan

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: Building this model requires setting up a 25-year weekly amortization schedule (1,300 periods) with dynamic weekly date generation starting from October 1, 2027. The modeler must correctly calculate the weekly interest rate under annual compounding—typically $(1 + 5\%)^{1/52} - 1$—and structure a Constant Principal Loan where the principal reduction is flat across all periods down to a $100,000 residual balance. Answering the questions will then require implementing robust lookup formulas (like XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH) to query exact weekly dates and SUMIFS to aggregate annual figures, followed by a thorough check of the date alignments and interest compounding logic.
